text:
Ethan (Sales): New RFP from Solarflare Health. Key asks: private/on-prem POC option, HSM BYOK, 6mo audit log retention, SLA 99.9, low-hallucination target (FDR <2% on their eval set), embedding dimensionality limit (512), and a capability matrix + tiered pricing. They attached a questionnaire and sample eval corpus.

Anjali (Solarflare): Quick context: clinical search use-case, strict PHI rules. We need an air-gapped POC option if possible, and a short report on how you measure hallucination. Target: 80 QPS embeddings steady, spikes to 250 for nightly indexing.

Priya (Solutions): Understood. Propose POC variants: 1) Private cloud VPC peering + HSM sim 2) On-prem air-gapped VM bundle for 7 days (limited infra) 3) Hosted dedicated with BYOK. POC plan draft will include perf runs and hallucination evals using their corpus. Est 12 business days prep for on-prem.

Oliver (Security): For PHI + on-prem: we'll need to validate network isolation checklist and provide an HSM integration runbook. Hallucination metrics: we can run answer-veracity evals and produce an ML explainability note. Flag: air-gapped on-prem has additional support costs and a short security attestation rather than SOC2.

Zara (Product): Model guidance: recommend embed-dim 512 to match their constraint; use quantized int8 embed model for latency. For chat/QA, provide fp16 baseline. Will document expected tradeoffs and include a hallucination measurement methodology in the matrix.

Priya (Solutions): POC infra snippet for infra team (for on-prem staging):

```
redwood_onprem_bundle:
  mode: airgapped
  nodes: 3
  node_type: t4g
  quant_profile: int8
  embed_dim: 512
  kms: hsm-stub
```

Rhea (Legal): If they require subcontractor lists or an on-site install, we need an SOW + amendment. Air-gapped installs will require an on-site statement of work and liability clause. Also check PHI processing terms in DPA.

Ethan (Sales): Attachments we plan to send: "solarflare_capmatrix_v1.xlsx", "sow_onprem_template.pdf", "hallucination_eval_note.md", "soc2_summary.pdf". Anjali can you confirm which specific PHI certs/regulatory docs you need?

Anjali (Solarflare): We need confirmation of data handling controls, evidence of penetration test within last 18 months, and a short runbook for on-prem installation. Also confirm whether token-level telemetry can be suppressed.

Oliver (Security): We can suppress content-level telemetry and provide anonymized usage metrics. Will attach "pen-test-2025-summary.pdf" and an "onprem_install_playbook.pdf".

Priya (Solutions): Pricing sketch: On-prem SOW + 2-week POC fixed fee (TBD), Dedicated reserved cluster for steady load $, hosted burst per-token for spikes. I'll put three scenarios in the quote.

Ethan (Sales): Next steps: Priya -> finalize POC runbook + SOW draft; Oliver -> RFI security answers + attachments; Zara -> capability matrix with model & hallucination columns; Rhea -> draft SOW/license clauses. I'll assemble and send Solarflare the packet by EOD Friday.

deploy-bot: Branch "solarflare-rfp" lint OK. CI passing.

Anjali (Solarflare): Great, thanks everyone. We'll review and propose POC weeks. :raised_hands:
